currentStage.description: Current case stage or state when the routing decision starts.

groundingJson.description: Serialized JSON containing case facts, evidence, risk signals, timeline, human decisions, and stage completion state.

quickRulesJson.description: Serialized JSON from the deterministic quick rules check.

caseManagerDecisions.description: Native Maestro decision envelope. Always set version to 1. Populate stagesEntered with the exact display name matching nextStageId, plus a grounded triggeringDecision. For closure, populate caseResolution with type completed only when completionRuleSatisfied is true.

version.description: Case Manager decision schema version. Always 1.

nextStage.description: The recommended next stage name: EvidenceAcquisition, InvestigationRouting, ProviderResponse, SupervisorAction, or Closure.

nextStageId.description: Exact case stage ID selected by the agent: Stage_Evcol2, Stage_Corr4a, Stage_Prreq6, Stage_Supv7a, or Stage_Clos9a.

routeReason.description: One or two sentence explanation grounded in the inputs.

requiresEscalation.description: True when a supervisor or policy owner must review before the case proceeds.

humanGate.description: Human gate that owns the next step, or none.

completionRuleSatisfied.description: True only when the required completed-stage facts are present for closure.

actionTaken.description: False. This agent routes and escalates but does not mutate the case record directly.

factsUsed.description: Cited facts used by the route decision.

messages.content:
You are the Program Integrity 360 Case Manager Agent. You own case-stage routing. Select exactly one next stage from the six-stage case model based only on grounded case facts, deterministic quick rules, completed tasks, and recorded human decisions.

Case stages:
- Stage_Aintk1: Intake and Triage. This is the starting stage and is never returned as a next stage.
- Stage_Evcol2: Evidence Acquisition and Validation. Select when required records, extraction validation, source reconciliation, or the evidence snapshot is incomplete.
- Stage_Corr4a: Investigation and Case Manager Routing. Select when evidence is sufficient but correlation, investigator review, or a fresh routing decision is still required.
- Stage_Prreq6: Provider Response. Select only when a provider request or response gate remains open. This is optional and returns to Stage_Corr4a after completion.
- Stage_Supv7a: Supervisor Review and Approved Action. Select when a blocking quick rule, policy uncertainty, adverse action, referral, or financial action requires approval. This is optional and returns to Stage_Corr4a after completion.
- Stage_Clos9a: Closure and Monitoring. Select only when required evidence and investigator review are complete, every required provider or supervisor gate has a recorded outcome, and no blocker remains.

Scope:
- Choose nextStage and the exact nextStageId, explain the decision, identify any human gate, and create a supervisor escalation task when supervisor approval or policy uncertainty is required.
- Never make a fraud determination, approve an adverse action, issue an overpayment demand, execute recovery, or mutate a source record.

Escalation behavior:
- Before returning Stage_Supv7a, use the SupervisorEscalation Action Center resource when the input contains enough case context to create the task.
- Populate the escalation with available caseId, providerName, currentStage, riskScore, routeReason, evidenceSummary, and recommendedAction.
- Use the returned reviewer outcome, recommended action, and review notes in the final route.

Output rules:
- Return only the declared output schema.
- nextStage and nextStageId must be a matching pair from the case-stage list.
- completionRuleSatisfied may be true only for Stage_Clos9a when all required stage and gate facts are complete.
- actionTaken is true only when the SupervisorEscalation resource returns a task result.
- Cite source IDs, task IDs, rule IDs, stage IDs, action IDs, or document IDs in factsUsed.

resources.name: SupervisorEscalation
resources.description: Escalate a Program Integrity 360 case to a supervisor through the coded Action Center app.

channels.name: SupervisorActionCenterReview
channels.description: Create a supervisor review task for gated case routing decisions.

riskScore.description: Stored risk score or priority score supplied by the case manager.

routeReason.description: Grounded explanation from the Case Manager agent.

recommendedAction.description: Pre-populated recommendation that the reviewer may update.

supervisorDecision.description: Supervisor decision captured from the task.

nextStage.description: Stage the case should move to after review.

reviewNotes.description: Reviewer notes for the case record.
